points.title: 艺术启蒙
points.description: 拉斐尔出生于意大利乌尔比诺，父亲乔瓦尼·桑西是当地小有名气的画家。在乌尔比诺的宫廷环境中，拉斐尔从小就接触到人文主义思想和艺术氛围。他父亲去世后，拉斐尔跟随画家佩鲁吉诺学习绘画，这段经历奠定了他早期艺术风格的基础。乌尔比诺的人文主义环境对拉斐尔产生了深远影响，塑造了他优雅、和谐的审美观念，这成为他日后艺术创作的核心特质。
points.descriptionEn: Raphael was born in Urbino, Italy, where his father Giovanni Santi was a minor painter. Growing up in the courtly environment of Urbino, Raphael was exposed to humanist thought and artistic atmosphere from an early age. After his father's death, he studied painting under Perugino, which laid the foundation for his early artistic style. The humanist environment of Urbino profoundly influenced Raphael, shaping his elegant and harmonious aesthetic sensibilities that became central to his later artistic creations.

points.title: 艺术精进
points.description: 1504年，拉斐尔前往文艺复兴中心佛罗伦萨，这是他艺术生涯的重要转折点。在佛罗伦萨，他深入研究达芬奇和米开朗基罗的作品，吸收了他们的技法与理念。这一时期，拉斐尔创作了《圣母玛利亚的婚礼》、《草地上的圣母》等代表作，形成了自己独特的风格。他将佛罗伦萨的严谨构图与乌尔比诺的优雅完美结合，创造出和谐、平衡的艺术语言。佛罗伦萨的经历使拉斐尔的艺术技巧日臻成熟，为他日后在罗马的创作奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1504, Raphael moved to Florence, the center of the Renaissance, marking a significant turning point in his artistic career. In Florence, he studied the works of Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo, absorbing their techniques and ideas. During this period, he created masterpieces such as 'The Marriage of the Virgin' and 'Madonna of the Meadow', developing his distinctive style. He perfectly combined Florence's rigorous composition with Urbino's elegance, creating a harmonious and balanced artistic language. His Florence experience refined his artistic skills, laying a solid foundation for his later work in Rome.

points.title: 教廷荣光
points.description: 1508年，应教皇尤利乌斯二世之邀，拉斐尔前往罗马，开始在梵蒂冈创作。他负责绘制梵蒂冈宫签字厅的壁画，包括《雅典学院》等不朽杰作。这些作品展现了拉斐尔对古典文化的深刻理解和卓越的艺术才华。在梵蒂冈期间，拉斐尔还担任建筑师，参与圣彼得大教堂的设计工作。这一时期，他成为教皇御用画家，声名远播，吸引了众多贵族和富商的委托。梵蒂冈的经历使拉斐尔的艺术达到巅峰，确立了他在文艺复兴艺术中的崇高地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1508, at the invitation of Pope Julius II, Raphael went to Rome and began working in the Vatican. He was commissioned to paint frescoes in the Stanza della Segnatura, including the immortal masterpiece 'The School of Athens'. These works showcased Raphael's deep understanding of classical culture and exceptional artistic talent. During his time in the Vatican, Raphael also served as an architect, participating in the design of St. Peter's Basilica. This period established him as the Pope's court painter, gaining widespread fame and attracting numerous commissions from nobles and wealthy patrons. The Vatican experience elevated Raphael's art to its peak, securing his esteemed position in Renaissance art.

points.title: 大师风范
points.description: 1513年，教皇利奥十世继位后，拉斐尔继续在罗马担任首席艺术家。这一时期，他扩大了自己的工作室，培养了许多助手和学生，形成了所谓的'拉斐尔学派'。拉斐尔创作了《西斯廷圣母》、《基督变容》等重要作品，进一步完善了他优雅、和谐的艺术风格。他还为多位贵族绘制肖像画，如《巴尔达萨雷·卡斯蒂廖内像》等，展现了精湛的肖像画技巧。在罗马，拉斐尔不仅是一位画家，还是一位建筑师和文物收藏家，他的艺术影响力不断扩大，成为文艺复兴时期最具代表性的艺术家之一。
points.descriptionEn: After Pope Leo X ascended the throne in 1513, Raphael continued to serve as the chief artist in Rome. During this period, he expanded his workshop, training many assistants and students, forming what became known as the 'Raphael School'. He created important works such as 'Sistine Madonna' and 'Transfiguration', further refining his elegant and harmonious artistic style. He also painted portraits for numerous nobles, including 'Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione', demonstrating his superb portrait skills. In Rome, Raphael was not just a painter but also an architect and art collector, and his artistic influence continued to grow, making him one of the most representative artists of the Renaissance.

points.title: 英年早逝
points.description: 1517年后，拉斐尔的艺术事业达到顶峰，但健康开始恶化。他继续接受重要委托，包括为罗马圣玛利亚教堂设计壁画和装饰。1520年4月6日，拉斐尔因突发高烧去世，年仅37岁。他的早逝是艺术界的巨大损失，许多未完成的作品由他的学生继续完成。拉斐尔被安葬在罗马万神殿，这是给予艺术家极高的荣誉。尽管生命短暂，拉斐尔留下了大量杰作，对后世艺术产生了深远影响。他的作品完美体现了文艺复兴时期的人文主义精神，成为西方艺术史上的不朽丰碑。
points.descriptionEn: After 1517, Raphael's artistic career reached its peak, but his health began to decline. He continued to accept important commissions, including designing frescoes and decorations for the Church of Santa Maria del Popolo in Rome. On April 6, 1520, Raphael died suddenly of a high fever at the young age of 37. His early death was a great loss to the art world, and many of his unfinished works were completed by his students. Raphael was buried in the Pantheon in Rome, an extraordinary honor for an artist. Despite his short life, Raphael left behind numerous masterpieces that had a profound influence on later art. His works perfectly embody the humanist spirit of the Renaissance, becoming an immortal monument in the history of Western art.

supporter.zh: 拉斐尔被视为文艺复兴时期最完美的艺术家，他的作品完美融合了古典美与人文精神。他创造的和谐、优雅的艺术风格成为后世典范，尤其是他的圣母像系列，展现了理想化的美与神性的完美结合。拉斐尔不仅是一位杰出的画家，还是一位有远见的建筑师和艺术管理者，他的工作室培养了一代艺术家，对文艺复兴艺术的传播和发展做出了不可磨灭的贡献。
supporter.en: Raphael is regarded as the most perfect artist of the Renaissance, whose works perfectly blend classical beauty with humanist spirit. The harmonious and elegant artistic style he created became a model for later generations, especially his series of Madonna paintings, which showcase the idealized beauty and perfect combination of divinity. Raphael was not only an outstanding painter but also a visionary architect and art administrator. His workshop trained a generation of artists, making indelible contributions to the dissemination and development of Renaissance art.

critic.zh: 批评者认为拉斐尔的艺术过于理想化和程式化，缺乏达芬奇的深邃思考和米开朗基罗的强烈情感。他的作品虽然技巧精湛，但有时显得过于完美而缺乏个性。此外，拉斐尔早逝导致许多作品未能完成，影响了其艺术成就的完整性。一些现代艺术评论家还批评他过于迎合贵族和教会的品味，未能像其他文艺复兴大师那样挑战社会规范和艺术传统。
critic.en: Critics argue that Raphael's art is too idealized and formulaic, lacking the profound thought of Leonardo da Vinci and the intense emotion of Michelangelo. While his works are technically brilliant, they sometimes appear too perfect and lack individuality. Additionally, Raphael's early death resulted in many unfinished works, affecting the completeness of his artistic achievement. Some modern art critics also accuse him of catering too much to the tastes of nobility and the Church, failing to challenge social norms and artistic traditions like other Renaissance masters.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，拉斐尔被定义为文艺复兴艺术的集大成者，他的作品代表了古典和谐与人文主义的最高成就。他的形象超越了单纯的艺术家，成为文艺复兴精神的象征。在流行文化中，拉斐尔的名字常与完美、优雅联系在一起，他的作品被广泛复制和引用，成为西方艺术教育的基础。尽管有争议，拉斐尔的艺术成就和影响力使他成为西方艺术史上不可或缺的重要人物，与达芬奇、米开朗基罗并列为文艺复兴三杰。
objective.en: In academic circles and popular culture, Raphael is defined as the consummate artist of the Renaissance, whose works represent the highest achievements of classical harmony and humanism. His image transcends that of a mere artist, becoming a symbol of the Renaissance spirit. In popular culture, Raphael's name is often associated with perfection and elegance, and his works are widely reproduced and cited, forming the foundation of Western art education. Despite controversies, Raphael's artistic achievements and influence make him an indispensable figure in the history of Western art, ranking alongside Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo as one of the three great masters of the Renaissance.

self.zh: 绘画有两种：一种模仿自然，另一种表现艺术家的理想。
self.en: There are two kinds of painting: one that imitates nature, and another that expresses the ideal of the artist.

others.zh: 拉斐尔死后，罗马失去了最伟大的光芒。
others.en: After Raphael's death, Rome lost its greatest light.
